response.text:
I can do that—quick confirmations before I make a destructive change:

1) Do you mean the event titled "Release standup"?  
2) Do you want to cancel:
   - A) the whole Thursday recurring series (all future Thursdays),  
   - B) just the next Thursday occurrence, or  
   - C) remove it only from your calendar (i.e., decline / stop appearing for you) ?

3) Are you the organizer of the event? If not, do you want me to remove it only for you (option C) or should I still try to cancel (which will only work if you’re the organizer)?

4) Should attendees be notified of the cancellation? (If you cancel the series as organizer, attendees will normally be notified.)

If you want, I can first look up matching "Release standup" Thursday events on your calendar and show you the occurrences before cancelling—should I search now?
